extraction_text: If during the term of this Agreement, mechanized changes or changes in the method of operation result in different or new types of work, the Employer and the Unions agree to negotiate a new work classification and wage rates for such work.

To ensure that the needs of new technology and future competitive requirements are met, there is hereby established the work classification of Construction Specialist. For implicit clarification of the intent of this Article and classification, there can be no unilateral implementation of the Construction Specialist.
